name: Indeed Scraper
description: Indeed scraper for Python and the command line: job listings for a role and location with structured salary ranges, benefits, employer rating and posting date, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no browser extension, proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: jobs
commands.help: Indeed job listings for a role and location
commands.description: Indeed job listings for a role and a location, with structured salary ranges, from the Indeed site of the country you pick.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Job title or keywords, e.g. "data engineer".

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: City, state or postcode, e.g. "New York".

inputs.name: posted_within_days
inputs.description: Only listings posted in the last N days (1–30).

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Which Indeed site to search, as an ISO country code: us (default) or another market's code, e.g. it for Italy.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many jobs to deliver at most (1–300). You pay only for delivered jobs.
